turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Yes. Let me do one example with you watching.
I ate ___ egg. What is the first sound? "e". Is it a vowel sound? Yes. So I write: I ate an egg.
So: "an" before a vowel sound, "a" before other sounds.
Right: I ate a sandwich. Wrong: I ate an sandwich.
Your try. Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
